summary:
Phase P2B (Product Version Diff / Compare) — 61/61 pytest GREEN. Added new TestP2BCompare class with 10 tests covering: endpoint structure (current/source/summary + 6 sections each with rows+summary, every row has key/status/current/source/changes), self-compare yields all-unchanged, 404 with 'tidak ditemukan' for missing current OR source SKU, recipe diff semantics (removed cable status='removed' with current=null/source!=null; changed cable has changes containing both qty_per_pcs and catatan_proses), bundle cables_in_bundle membership synthesis (removing GND-OUT from recipe flagged its bundle as 'changed' with changes=['cables_in_bundle']), pin_map nested pin_diff with summary on changed/unchanged rows, work_instructions step_diff present when WI exists in both, QC keyed by nama (added item TEST_extra_qc_item correctly diffed), common_mistakes keyed by kesalahan text (added kesalahan TEST_kesalahan_xyz diffed), role access (admin/prod/qc all 200). To avoid SKU collision with TestP2AClone (which uses V2/V3 under parallel 2-worker xdist loadscope), the P2B fixture clones to RFL-AOD-H11-V4. Cleanup fixture extended to include V4.

Frontend e2e (Playwright, Chromium 1920x1080) verified across all three roles — admin/redi/leni:
 - /products/RFL-AOD-H11-V1: compare-product-btn count=0 (PASS), clone-product-btn=1 (PASS, regression intact).
 - /products/RFL-AOD-H11-V2: compare-product-btn visible (PASS); click navigates to /products/RFL-AOD-H11-V2/compare/RFL-AOD-H11-V1 (PASS).
 - Compare page title 'RFL-AOD-H11-V2 vs RFL-AOD-H11-V1' (PASS).
 - Texts present: 'Produk Saat Ini','Produk Pembanding','Ringkasan Perubahan','Cetak','Bandingkan' (all PASS, all roles).
 - 6 SummaryCards rendered (sum-recipe,sum-bundles,sum-wi,sum-pinmap,sum-qc,sum-mistakes) — PASS.
 - 6 Tabs rendered (diff-tab-recipe/bundles/wi/pinmap/qc/mistakes) — PASS.
 - compare-summary-text contains Indonesian 'perubahan recipe' phrasing — PASS.
 - chip-changed count=3 visible on recipe tab (PASS); GND-OUT removal correctly shown (screenshot confirms 'Diubah' on Bundle H with 'Kabel pembanding: GND-OUT').
 - Bundle cards rendered (11) with chip status badges — PASS.
 - print-compare button present and enabled (PASS).
 - Indonesian chip labels 'Dihapus','Diubah','Tidak berubah' all rendered. ('Ditambahkan' not rendered because no 'added' items exist in the test scenario; STATUS_STYLE.added.label='Ditambahkan' is defined in Compare.jsx — verified by code inspection.)
 - source-select dropdown opens (1 option visible because there are no other versions beyond the source).
 - Production (redi) and QC (leni) both successfully load /products/RFL-AOD-H11-V2/compare/RFL-AOD-H11-V1 directly (no 403); all 6 tabs/summary visible to both — PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Compare.jsx renders each child diff component twice — once inside Tabs and once inside the print-only 'hidden print:block' block. data-testids like recipe-diff-<code> and chip-<status> therefore appear with count=2 in DOM. Not a bug (Tailwind 'hidden' hides print copy on screen), but tests using strict count==1 will misfire — use .first or count>=1.
_diff_by_key uses str(k) for the row key. For pin_diff (key by pin_number int) this stringifies; relay row code in routes.py does int(row['key']) when fetching pins, so consistent. OK.

Bundle cables_in_bundle membership change is synthesised by sorting cable_code lists per bundle from current/source recipes — correctly flips status from 'unchanged' to 'changed' and decrements unchanged/increments changed in summary. Verified in test_bundle_membership_change_detected.
QC items are keyed by 'nama' (not id) — important because clone regenerates ids. Confirmed working with TEST_extra_qc_item.
Compare endpoint uses get_current_user (not require_roles) — all 3 roles get 200. Confirmed.
Backend file routes.py is now ~1100 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routes/products.py, routes/work_orders.py, routes/auth.py for maintainability. Low priority.
Compare.jsx (~400 lines) packs 6 child diff components in one file — acceptable, but could be split into /pages/compare/* for readability if it grows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% across all 3 roles on all P2B review items

seed_data_creation: Frontend e2e seeded RFL-AOD-H11-V2 (clone of V1 with GND-OUT removed + qty/catatan changed on first cable). Pytest seeded RFL-AOD-H11-V4 within TestP2BCompare and cleans up. Post-frontend cleanup deleted V2 + cascade and reset V1.status='Released' / cleared parent/source/version_group. DB confirmed clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P2B all review items GREEN. Note: Compare.jsx renders diff components TWICE (Tabs + hidden print:block) — data-testid selectors yield count=2 in DOM; use .first or count>=1, not ==1. Backend test class TestP2BCompare uses RFL-AOD-H11-V4 (NOT V2) to avoid xdist loadscope race with TestP2AClone which uses V2/V3. cleanup_versions_around fixture and _cleanup_versions helper now include V4. data-testids on Compare page: compare-title, compare-summary-text, compare-source-select, print-compare, sum-{recipe|bundles|wi|pinmap|qc|mistakes}, diff-tab-{recipe|bundles|wi|pinmap|qc|mistakes}, recipe-diff-<cable_code>, bundle-diff-<bundle_code>, wi-diff-<bundle_code>, pinmap-diff-<relay_number>, qc-diff-<nama>, mistake-diff-<kesalahan>, chip-{added|removed|changed|unchanged}. ProductDetail has compare-product-btn conditional on product.parent_sku||product.source_sku.
